outcome: Time to reach full enteral feeds
Time to reach full oral feeds
cohort: The study included 240 consecutive neonates >35 weeks of gestation diagnosed with hypoxic-ischemic encephalopathy (HIE) admitted to a single center between January 2015 and December 2020.
finding: Neonates with HIE receiving hypothermia therapy experienced significantly longer times to reach full oral feeds, and the risk of NEC was associated with the severity of end-organ dysfunction in the first week of life rather than brain injury severity or hypothermia therapy itself.
